Bettina, I saved the draft to June Osei-Lark (joseilark@pemberline.com) with the subject "PHL label cleanup." It's in your mailbox and hasn't been sent.

It has Sofia's three bullets and your clarification: the Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows, and the Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments. The draft has no money figures, so nothing needed approval.
